notes.title: Small Update
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone! We've just released a small update addressing a couple of issues reported by the community:[/p][list][*][p][b]Fixed a bug where the player would stop moving after throwing a box.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed a bug that prevented throwing boxes upward or downward.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks for your continued support and feedback![/p]

notes.title: Major Update Now Live!
notes.content: [p]Get ready for fresh challenges! This new update brings [b]20 brand-new levels[/b] and [b]various bug fixes[/b] to make your experience smoother and more fun. Update now and take it to the next level![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301173/65ebd06119e7e5c261243b4cc763a43c99b4b529.png"][/img][/p]
